source_law.title: Operation of vehicles within a roundabout (B)
source_law.text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle entering a roundabout shall yield the right-of-way to vehicles already in the roundabout and wait for a gap in traffic before entering.
